     \]

     y = \frac{(\sqrt{19} - \sqrt{3})^2}{4} - 4 = \frac{19 + 3 - 2\sqrt{57}}{4} - 4 = \frac{22 - 2\sqrt{57}}{4} - 4 = \frac{11 - \sqrt{57}}{2} - 4
     \]

     y = \frac{11 - \sqrt{57}}{2} - \frac{8}{2} = \frac{11 - \sqrt{57} - 8}{2} = \frac{3 - \sqrt{57}}{2}
